answer: Escrowed Introducer Liability. Each new identity must be launched by an existing member who posts an escrow covering the newcomer's first N transactions; if the newcomer behaves maliciously, that escrow is forfeited to victims, and the introducer's cedar record is flagged. An attacker cloning identities must therefore recruit distinct, accountable introducers for each clone, so every clone imposes real collateral and reputational exposure on a separate party.
